section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1980
title: 10 ## Union Territories : The incidence of accidental deaths went up to 1.5 percent in 1980 over 1979 in the Union Territories as a whole while a decline of 3.6 percent was recorded in 1979 over 1978. The Union Territories which registered a decline in the total number of accidental deaths in 1980 over 1979 were, Mizoram (30.4%), Pondicherry (1.8%), and Goa, Daman & Diu (1.7%) and the Union Territories which registered an increase were Arunachal Pradesh (34.5%), Chandigarh (29.0%), Dadra & Nagar Haveli (28.6%), Andaman & Nicobar Islands (9.7%) and Delhi (1.3%). In Lakshadweep 5 cases of accidental deaths were reported in year 1980 as against nil in 1979.
